--- title: "[Selectors]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Namespace of factory methods for built-in shoez column selectors. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/tidymodels/shoez/blob/examples-section/shoez/selectors.py#L348-L615){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python Selectors() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} All factories return a `ShoezSelector` that composes with ``&`` / ``|`` / ``~`` / ``-``. See ``design/selectors.md``. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} A selector stands in for an explicit column list and is resolved against the frame at fit time. Here ``starts_with("x")`` picks up ``x1`` and ``x2`` but leaves ``y`` untouched: ::: {#1e414b29 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} df = pd.DataFrame( {"x1": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0], "x2": [4.0, 5.0, 6.0], "y": [7.0, 8.0, 9.0]} ) recipe = Recipe().add(StepNormalize(s.starts_with("x"))) fitted = recipe.fit(df) fitted.transform(df) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
x1 x2 y
0 -1.0 -1.0 7.0
1 0.0 0.0 8.0
2 1.0 1.0 9.0
``` ::: ::: ## Methods {.doc-methods}
